def main():
    n = int(input())
    kn = [0] + [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]  # 1-indexed list
    
    # Selection sort
    for i in range(1, n):
        k = i
        min_val = kn[i]
        for j in range(i+1, n+1):
            if kn[j] < min_val:
                min_val = kn[j]
                k = j
        kn[k], kn[i] = kn[i], kn[k]
    
    median_index = (1 + n) // 2
    print(kn[median_index])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
